importantFindings: Cape Dory 28 common-hull draft canonicalized to 2 ft 11 in from brochure-derived association material; HMY's 2 ft 9 in is retained as a conflicting secondary assertion.
Cape Dory 28 Cruiser, Flybridge and Open Fisherman remain separate variants on the same proven hull.
Cape Dory 40 Explorer production range corrected to 1992–1994; builder changed from Cape Dory hull #1 to Newport Shipyards on later boats without changing model identity.
Cheoy Lee original-brochure material supports 28, 32 and 35 trawler dimensions; 36 MKII dimensions are not generalized to the entire broad 36 Trawler record.
Gulfstar 36 and 43 share hull lineage with their motorsailer counterparts and receive explicit 1975 MK II layout production phases.
Gulfstar 44 Motor Cruiser is full-displacement despite motor-yacht styling.
Californian 34 and 38 LRC are trawler-styled but modified-V, planing-capable hulls; B-Atlas now separates family/style from hull behaviour.
